flavor_text: The old forest road narrows beneath a bright green canopy.
A quiet howl answers from the bend ahead.
Briars close behind you as a brittle shape steps forward.
A covered cart waits beside the trail, its little lantern still warm.
The ground softens underfoot, and the glade begins to move.
Clear water gathers in a stone basin covered in silver leaves.
Pale lights drift between the trees, each one trailing a bitter mist.
Steel flashes once in the canopy, then stills.
An armored sentinel blocks the last rise before the heartwood.
At the forest center, the oldest roots twist around a dark crown.
Sparks linger between the trees like unfinished thoughts.
Glass clinks somewhere off the path, then a cork pops.
The undergrowth parts as if greeting an old friend.
A notice flutters on a pine, pinned by a fresh arrow.
Dusk settles early, and candle-smoke finds you first.
Frost feathers the hollow before you feel the cold.
A sketched map flutters down from the canopy.
Gold eyes open along the game trail and do not blink.
Warm ash swirls upward from a charred stump.
Muddy paws and a wagging stick announce a new friend.
A ruined lectern still keeps its place among the trees.
Leaf litter shifts, and something bony sits up politely.
A mana bloom trembles as starlight drinks from its petals.
Giggles ring a mushroom circle just off the path.
A living buckler blocks the narrow pass ahead.
